rooms.name: Bridge over the Raven River
rooms.desc: An old stone span over the Raven River.
rooms.dm: The Old Svalich Road crosses here on its way to Krezk (S).

rooms.name: Raven River Crossroads
rooms.desc: Roads branch at a weathered signpost: Krezk to the north, toward a stone bridge glimpsed through the trees; Vallaki to the east, up a gentle rise; The Wizard of Wines to the south-west, gently downhill.
rooms.dm: Always check for a random encounter here. Along this stretch a branch also heads north, soon a dirt path to Van Richten's Tower on Lake Baratok (V), and another heads south to become the Tsolenka Pass road (T) along Mount Ghakis. The winery road dips south and turns from road to gravel trail.

objects.label: Arching stone bridge
objects.desc: An arching stone bridge spans the river, glimpsed through the trees from the crossroads.

objects.label: Signpost
objects.desc: A weathered three-armed signpost: Krezk, Vallaki, The Wizard of Wines.

objects.label: North, over the bridge: the village of Krezk (S).
East: the Old Svalich Road climbs gently toward Vallaki (N).
North: the dirt path to Van Richten's Tower on Lake Baratok (V).
South: the road that becomes the Tsolenka Pass (T).
South-west: the gravel trail down to the Wizard of Wines winery (W).
